Reading in the data files

atp79 <- read_sav("ATP W79.sav")
atp80 <- read_sav("ATP W80.sav")

common_ids <- intersect(atp79$QKEY, atp80$QKEY)

# Number of respondents who appear in both: 5175
length(common_ids)
[1] 5175
# Merging into one dataset
atpfinal <- merge(atp79, atp80, by = "QKEY", all = FALSE, suffixes = c("_w79", "_w80"))

Selecting and cleaning variables

# Dropping unnecessary values
atp <- atpfinal %>%  
mutate(
    CAMP20NEWS2_a_W79 = case_when(
      CAMP20NEWS2_a_W79 == 99 ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ CAMP20NEWS2_a_W79
    ),
    CAMP20NEWS2_b_W79 = case_when(
      CAMP20NEWS2_b_W79 == 99 ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ CAMP20NEWS2_b_W79
    ),
    CAMP20NEWS2_c_W79 = case_when(
      CAMP20NEWS2_c_W79 == 99 ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ CAMP20NEWS2_c_W79
    ),
    CAMP20NEWS2_d_W79 = case_when(
      CAMP20NEWS2_d_W79 == 99 ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ CAMP20NEWS2_d_W79
    ),
    CAMP20NEWS2_e_W79 = case_when(
      CAMP20NEWS2_e_W79 == 99 ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ CAMP20NEWS2_e_W79
    ),
    CAMP20NEWS2_f_W79 = case_when(
      CAMP20NEWS2_f_W79 == 99 ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ CAMP20NEWS2_f_W79
    ),
    CAMP20NEWS2_g_W79 = case_when(
      CAMP20NEWS2_g_W79 == 99 ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ CAMP20NEWS2_g_W79
    ),
    CAMP20NEWS2_h_W79 = case_when(
      CAMP20NEWS2_h_W79 == 99 ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ CAMP20NEWS2_h_W79
    ),
    F_AGECAT_w80 = case_when(
      F_AGECAT_w80 == 99 ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ F_AGECAT_w80
    ),
    F_GENDER_w80 = case_when(
  F_GENDER_w80 %in% c(3, 99) ~ NA_integer_,
  TRUE ~ F_GENDER_w80
    ),
    F_INC_SDT1_w80 = case_when(
      F_INC_SDT1_w80 == 99 ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ F_INC_SDT1_w80
    ),
    F_EDUCCAT2_w80 = case_when(
      F_EDUCCAT2_w80 == 99 ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ F_EDUCCAT2_w80
    ),
    F_IDEO_w80 = case_when(
      F_IDEO_w80 == 99 ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ F_IDEO_w80
    ),
    F_PARTYSUM_FINAL_w80 = case_when(
      F_PARTYSUM_FINAL_w80 == 9 ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ F_PARTYSUM_FINAL_w80
    ),
    JAN6HEARD_W80 = case_when(
      JAN6HEARD_W80 == 99 ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ JAN6HEARD_W80
    ),
    JAN6_DTRESP_W80 = case_when(
      JAN6_DTRESP_W80 == 99 ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ JAN6_DTRESP_W80
    ),
    TRUMPFUT_W80 = case_when(
      TRUMPFUT_W80 == 99 ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ TRUMPFUT_W80
    )
  )

# Recoding and reordering variables
atp <- atp %>%  
mutate(
    F_GENDER_w80 = case_when(
      F_GENDER_w80 == 1 ~ 0,
      F_GENDER_w80 == 2 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    F_IDEO_w80 = case_when( 
    F_IDEO_w80 == 1 ~ 5,
    F_IDEO_w80 == 2 ~ 4,
    F_IDEO_w80 == 3 ~ 3,
    F_IDEO_w80 == 4 ~ 2,
    F_IDEO_w80 == 5 ~ 1
    ),
    JAN6HEARD_W80 = case_when( 
    JAN6HEARD_W80 == 1 ~ 3,
    JAN6HEARD_W80 == 2 ~ 2,
    JAN6HEARD_W80 == 3 ~ 1
    ),
    JAN6_DTRESP_W80 = case_when( 
    JAN6_DTRESP_W80 == 1 ~ 3,
    JAN6_DTRESP_W80 == 2 ~ 2,
    JAN6_DTRESP_W80 == 3 ~ 1
    ),
    TRUMPFUT_W80 = case_when(
      TRUMPFUT_W80 == 1 ~ 1,
      TRUMPFUT_W80 == 2 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  )

## Media variables

media_vars <- c("CAMP20NEWS2_a_W79", "CAMP20NEWS2_b_W79", "CAMP20NEWS2_c_W79",
                "CAMP20NEWS2_d_W79", "CAMP20NEWS2_e_W79", "CAMP20NEWS2_f_W79",
                "CAMP20NEWS2_g_W79", "CAMP20NEWS2_h_W79")

# Recoding each to binary: 1 = uses, 0 = does not use
atp <- atp %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(media_vars),
                ~ ifelse(. %in% c(1, 2), 1,
                         ifelse(. == 3, 0, NA)),
                .names = "use_{col}"))

atp <- atp %>%
  mutate(
    total_sources = rowSums(select(., starts_with("use_")), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Dropping respondents with no news sources consulted
atp <- atp %>% filter(total_sources > 0)

table(atp$total_sources)

  1   2   3   4   5   6   7   8 
497 799 826 782 750 701 331 238 
# Filtering for only Republicans / Lean Republican
atp_rep <- atp %>% filter(F_PARTYSUM_FINAL_w80 == 1)

Updating the media categories

# Creating variables for mainstream conservative media (use_fox) and fringe/talk radio (use_talk)
atp_rep_2 <- atp_rep %>%
  mutate(
    use_fox = ifelse(CAMP20NEWS2_a_W79 %in% c(1, 2), 1, 0),
    use_talk = ifelse(CAMP20NEWS2_h_W79 %in% c(1, 2), 1, 0)
  )

# Creating groups for the media variables
atp_rep_2 <- atp_rep_2 %>%
  mutate(
    cons_media_type = case_when(
      use_fox == 1 & use_talk == 0 ~ "Mainstream_Conservative",
      use_fox == 0 & use_talk == 1 ~ "Fringe_Conservative",
      use_fox == 1 & use_talk == 1 ~ "Both",
      use_fox == 0 & use_talk == 0 ~ "Neither"
    )
  )

atp_rep_2$cons_media_type <- factor(
  atp_rep_2$cons_media_type,
  levels = c("Mainstream_Conservative", "Fringe_Conservative", "Both", "Neither")
)

table(atp_rep_2$cons_media_type)

                    713                     146                     858 
                Neither 
                    346

# Labels
pretty_names <- c(
  "(Intercept)" = "Intercept",
  "cons_media_typeFringe_Conservative" = "Fringe Media",
  "cons_media_typeBoth" = "Fringe + Conservative Media",
  "cons_media_typeNeither" = "Neither Media",
  "F_IDEO_w80" = "Ideology",
  "JAN6HEARD_W80" = "Exposure to Jan 6 Information",
  "JAN6_DTRESP_W80" = "Responsibility Attributed",
  "F_GENDER_w80" = "Gender",
  "F_AGECAT_w80" = "Age",
  "F_EDUCCAT2_w80" = "Education",
  "F_INC_SDT1_w80" = "Income"
)

# Keep only non-missing cases on key variables
atp_rep_3 <- atp_rep_2 %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(cons_media_type),
    !is.na(JAN6_DTRESP_W80),
    !is.na(TRUMPFUT_W80),
    !is.na(F_IDEO_w80),
    !is.na(F_GENDER_w80),
    !is.na(F_AGECAT_w80),
    !is.na(F_EDUCCAT2_w80),
    !is.na(F_INC_SDT1_w80)
  ) 

atp_rep_3$resp_binary <- ifelse(atp_rep_3$JAN6_DTRESP_W80 %in% c(2, 3), 1, 0)
table(atp_rep_3$resp_binary)

# Model 1: Media exposure > Responsibility

m1 <- glm(
  resp_binary ~ cons_media_type + F_IDEO_w80 + JAN6HEARD_W80 +
    F_GENDER_w80 + F_AGECAT_w80 + F_EDUCCAT2_w80 + F_INC_SDT1_w80,
  data = atp_rep_3,
  weights = WEIGHT_W80,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)

# Predict probabilities
probs_m1 <- predict(m1, newdata = atp_rep_3, type = "response")

# Convert to predicted binary values (0/1)
pred_m1 <- ifelse(probs_m1 >= 0.5, 1, 0)

# Tabulate predictions vs actual
tab_m1 <- table(Predicted = pred_m1, Actual = atp_rep_3$resp_binary)
tab_m1

# Plot for m1 (Mediator)

plot_m1 <- ggplot(tidy_m1, aes(x = reorder(term, estimate), y = estimate, color = significant)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), width = 0.2, size = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Yes" = "#1f77b4", "No" = "#7f7f7f")) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "cons_media_typeFringe_Conservative" = "Fringe Media",
    "cons_media_typeBoth" = "Fringe + Mainstream Conservative Media",
    "cons_media_typeNeither" = "Neither Media",
    "F_IDEO_w80" = "Ideology",
    "JAN6HEARD_W80" = "Jan 6 Information Exposure",
    "F_EDUCCAT2_w80" = "Education",
    "F_INC_SDT1_w80" = "Income",
    "F_AGECAT_w80" = "Age",
    "F_GENDER_w80" = "Gender")) +
  labs(
    x = "Predictor",
    y = "Odds Ratio",
    color = "Significant",
    title = "Mediator Model (m1): Odds Ratios with 95% CI"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica") +  # Set font
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#ffffff", color = NA),  # light gray background
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#DEDFDF", color = NA),   # panel white
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#ffffff"),             # gray grid lines
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "#333333"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11)
  )

# Predicted probabilities for m1 (Mediator)
# Predict probability of assigning responsibility (resp_binary)

atp_rep_3$pred_prob_m1 <- predict(m1, newdata = atp_rep_3, type = "response")

# Mean predicted probability by media type

atp_rep_3 %>%
group_by(cons_media_type) %>%
summarise(mean_pred_prob = mean(pred_prob_m1, na.rm = TRUE))

  cons_media_type         mean_pred_prob
  <fct>                            <dbl>

3 Both                             0.461
4 Neither                          0.713
# Predicted probabilities for m2 (Outcome)
# Predict probability of supporting Trump (TRUMPFUT_W80)

atp_rep_3$pred_prob_m2 <- predict(m2, newdata = atp_rep_3, type = "response")

atp_rep_3 %>%
group_by(resp_binary) %>%
summarise(mean_pred_prob = mean(pred_prob_m2, na.rm = TRUE))

  resp_binary mean_pred_prob
        <dbl>          <dbl>
1           0          0.862
2           1          0.343

Mediation Analysis Plots

# Prepare mediation effects
med_effects <- data.frame(
  Effect = c("Indirect (ACME)", "Direct (ADE)", "Total Effect"),
  Estimate = c(med_out$d0, med_out$z0, med_out$tau.coef),
  Lower = c(med_out$d0.ci[1], med_out$z0.ci[1], med_out$tau.ci[1]),
  Upper = c(med_out$d0.ci[2], med_out$z0.ci[2], med_out$tau.ci[2])
)

# Adjusted mediation effects plot

ggplot(med_effects, aes(x = Effect, y = Estimate)) +
geom_point(size = 4, color = "#4FB663") +
geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper), width = 0.2, size = 0.8, color = "#4FB663") +
geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#7f7f7f") +
coord_flip() +
labs(
x = "",
y = "Effect Estimate",
title = "Mediation Analysis: Direct, Indirect, and Total Effects"
) +
theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica") +
theme(
plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#ffffff", color = NA),
panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#DEDFDF", color = NA),
panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#ffffff"),
panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "#333333"),
axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
legend.position = "none"
)

Descriptive Statistics

# Descriptive Statistics

vars <- c("resp_binary", "cons_media_type", "F_IDEO_w80", "F_GENDER_w80", "F_AGECAT_w80", "F_EDUCCAT2_w80", "F_INC_SDT1_w80", "JAN6HEARD_W80", "F_PARTYSUM_FINAL_w80")
skim_out <- skim(atp_rep_3[vars])

# Create HTML table
html_table <- kable(skim_out, format = "html") %>%
  kable_styling()

# Save to HTML file
save_kable(html_table, "skim_descriptives.html")

desc <- describe(atp_rep_3[vars])

# Convert describe() output to HTML manually
html <- paste0(
  "<html><body><h2>Descriptive Statistics</h2>",
  "<table border='1' cellpadding='5'>",
  "<tr><th>", paste(colnames(desc), collapse="</th><th>"), "</th></tr>",
  paste(
    apply(desc, 1, function(row)
      paste0("<tr><td>", paste(row, collapse="</td><td>"), "</td></tr>")
    ),
    collapse=""
  ),
  "</table></body></html>"
)

writeLines(html, "descriptive_stats.html")
# extra visualizations

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)

# Prepare data
pred_m1_df <- as.data.frame(ggpredict(m1, terms = "cons_media_type")) %>%
  mutate(
    media_clean = case_when(
      x == "Fringe_Conservative"    ~ "Only Fringe",
      x == "Both"                   ~ "Mainstream & Fringe",
      x == "Neither"                ~ "None",
      x == "Mainstream_Conservative"~ "Only Mainstream"
    ),
    pct = round(predicted * 100),
    media_clean = reorder(media_clean, predicted)
  )

plot_economist <- ggplot(pred_m1_df, aes(y = media_clean, x = predicted)) +
  # Subtle background pill representing 0 to 100%
  geom_segment(aes(y = media_clean, yend = media_clean, x = 0, xend = 1),
               color = "#F0F2F5", linewidth = 8, lineend = "round") +
  # 95% Confidence range as a soft colored capsule
  geom_segment(aes(y = media_clean, yend = media_clean, x = conf.low, xend = conf.high),
               color = "#E1CBD0", linewidth = 6, lineend = "round") +
  # Main estimate dot
  geom_point(color = "#d62728", size = 5.5) +
  # Number label right above/beside point
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(pct, "%")), 
            vjust = -1.2, fontface = "bold", size = 4.2, color = "#0F172A") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(), limits = c(-0.02, 1.05), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
  labs(
    title = "Media consumption matters for perceptions of violence responsibility",
    subtitle = "Predicted likelihood of Republicans considering Trump responsible for January 6 Capitol attacks",
    x = NULL, 
    y = "Type of Right-Wing Media Consumption",
    caption = "Shaded band indicates 95% confidence interval • Data: Pew Research Center American Trends Panel"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#FAFAF9", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#FAFAF9", color = NA),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, color = "#1C1917", margin = margin(b = 4)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "#78716C", margin = margin(b = 20)),
    plot.caption.position = "plot", # <-- Aligns to the outer image edge
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 8.5, color = "#A8A29E", hjust = 0.9, margin = margin(t = 16)), # <-- Right-aligned
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11, face = "plain", color = "#78716C", margin = margin(r = 12)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", color = "#292524"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9.5, color = "#A8A29E"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#E7E5E4", linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "dotted"),
    plot.margin = margin(20, 25, 20, 20)
  )

plot_economist
